topic: Choose a restaurant for a mixed-preference group dinner

scenario.topic: Choose a restaurant for a mixed-preference group dinner
scenario.opening_question: Which restaurant gives the best compromise between price, dietary fit, travel time, and atmosphere?

options.name: Corner Ramen
options.upside: warm, quick, and easy to organize
options.concern: may not feel special enough for everyone
options.best_for: a low-effort dinner with predictable timing

options.name: La Piazza
options.best_for: a familiar compromise for mixed tastes

options.upside: best dietary fit and calm setting
options.tradeoff: less appealing for people wanting meat dishes
options.concern: some may see it as too niche

options.concern: may not satisfy the dietary requirement well
